description:
Get a product's full collection: coverage notes, design summary, and every captured screen
grouped into onboarding flow, marketing pages, and in-product screens.

Use this to explore a competitor's complete UI: their signup flow, pricing page, dashboard,
settings, and other screens. Each screen has notes and an image URL.

productId.description: Product id from listProducts, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_product

counts.description: A flow step can show the same screenshot as a product or marketing screen (same id), so the per-kind counts can add up to more than screenshots.

scope.description:
What was captured. marketing: logged-out marketing pages only. public-demo: logged out, but real
product surfaces or public demos were used. task-incomplete: signed in, but the journey stops before
its result. signed-in: signed in, and the journey reaches its result.

scopeLabel.description: Scope in words: Marketing only, Public demo, Task incomplete or Signed in.

kind.description: flow is an onboarding step, marketing a public web page, product an in-app screen.

previewUrl.description: Screen-sized preview (the top of long pages). Present on pick options and related screens.

productName.description: Present on pick options and related screens.

style.description: What the screen looks like, judged from its first viewport (tags/style-spec.md). Searchable through q.

accentHue.description: The accent hue of buttons and highlights, or none.

aesthetic.description: One or two of minimal, editorial, playful, technical, glassy, bold, warm, data-dense, retro, corporate.

caption.description: What makes the screen look the way it does.

imagery.description: One or two of none, product-ui, photography, illustration, 3d, icons-only, charts.

tags.description: Design-problem tags. The first pattern is the primary one. See listTags.
